description: Toronto Water produced this dataset of watermain breaks within the City of Toronto, giving the date and location of each break over a 27-year period (1990 to 2016). Coverage is the City of Toronto. The data are free under the Open Government Licence - Toronto as an Excel file and a WGS84 file. Caveats: the files hold only date, year and coordinates, with no pipe material, diameter or age, and they end in 2016; a public request to update the data is open on the portal. Simulation uses: break histories for pipe failure rate models and the resilience of a distribution network. Related records: Calgary's water main breaks (data-calgary-water-main-breaks).
